name: Ramco Solutions
old_description: Let us help you solve your food conveyance issues. From packaging conveyors, meat conveyors, cook plant conveyors and much more.
about:
Ramco Solutions, based in Laurel, Delaware, traces its roots to 1995 when Brian Ramey and a partner founded Planned Poultry Renovations after Ramey's engineering roles at Perdue Farms and Townsend’s. The current company emerged as a 21st‑century evolution of that business, now led by Ramey alongside his son Kolby and daughter Hali.

The company designs, fabricates, and installs food‑grade conveyance systems, mezzanines, maintenance platforms, and custom sheet‑metal components. Its shop runs a 4 kW fiber laser (cutting up to 1" mild steel, 0.75" stainless and aluminum), a 180‑ton press brake, a 110‑ton iron worker, a 4‑roll plate roll, a CNC router for plastics, a wet saw, and a 10'×20' sandblast booth. Capabilities also include TIG/MIG/stick welding, 3D laser scanning, 3D CAD modeling, Ramcoat non‑slip coating application, and 3D printing in polycarbonate, carbon‑fiber blends, and Ultem.

Ramco serves food‑processing plants, poultry operations, food‑and‑beverage manufacturers, and food‑service contractors. Project examples include a debone renovation, rechiller roof‑access stairs, a wing cyclone platform, and tray‑pack stairs. The firm also supplies parts and components to other builders of food‑grade conveyors and machinery.

The company’s stated mission is to deliver innovative design solutions through plug‑and‑play modular conveyor models, standardized parts, and an easy quoting process. Its vision emphasizes new equipment development via research and development, while its values highlight pioneering, ownership, boldness, adaptability, family, faith, safety, and solving problems today.
